data.content_ref: inline:The isolated node is compatible with SRC_001: SRC_001 proposes that separation of authoring and checking is not strictly necessary — a self-executed test yields an external observable distinct from the claim text. The isolated node applies this to the single-engine case: a deterministic execution check within one engine is genuinely independent if it produces a result that could contradict the claim. REFUTED IF: a self-executed check by an LLM is shown to be systematically biased toward confirming the engine's own claims (implementation alignment), such that the 'external observable' is actually a restatement dressed as execution — the compatibility breaks and the isolated node becomes a non-example.
